lines: The Wending Vale was green once. Rivers sang, meadows hummed, and wildkin walked beside the people of the valley.
Then came the Hush. Year by year the colour drained away. Streams slowed to mud. Flowers stayed shut.
The wildkin grew wary and hid. And people... stopped listening to them.
The old stories say the Vale's heart, the Wellspring, only runs while people and wildkin trust each other.
In the village of Fernhollow, a young tender named Rowan is about to find out if the stories are true.
Ah, Rowan. I'm Tamsin, Keeper of the grove. These three wandered down from the hills, lost and hungry.
Nobody can own a wildkin. But one of them might choose to walk with you, if you choose it too.
It's chosen you back. Look at that! Be kind to each other.
When you're ready, come up Bramble Lane to the grove. Your Gran will want to see you first.
Go and see your Gran, Rowan. The cottage with the red roof.
This is the Wellspring Grove. Feel how quiet it is? The brambles have shut the way to the spring.
Every wildkin that trusts you wakes the land a little. Befriend three, and I think the brambles will give way.
Listen to it sing! You did this, Rowan. You and your friends.
The Vale is long, and the Hush runs deep. But today the grove remembers.
The brambles have pulled back! Go on, the Wellspring is just ahead. Lay your hand on the water.
There you are! And who's this little one? Oh, it's lovely. Keeper Tamsin brought it?
Listen, love. The grove up the Lane has gone grey as ash, and the stream with it.
Make friends out there. Not fights, friends. Here, take some treats and salves, and a few coins.
The Mender down the street will patch you both up for free. Off you go, and come home for supper!
I heard it from the window, Rowan. The spring, singing! I haven't heard that in ten years.
Supper's on the stove. Bring all your friends.
Mind the tall grass, love. That's where the shy ones hide.
If you've had a long day, a rest at the Mender's does wonders.
Welcome to the Mender's hut. Let me see your friends. There, there...
All better! Come back any time.
Pell's Pantry! Treats for every kind of wildkin, and salves for scraped knees.
Come again!
The door is locked. A note says: "Gone to the market at Lowmere. Back in spring."
Gran's mailbox. There's a seed catalogue in it, ten years out of date.

FERNHOLLOW
North: Bramble Lane and the Wellspring Grove.
MENDER'S HUT (left)    PELL'S PANTRY (right)

BRAMBLE LANE
Wild wildkin in the tall grass. Be gentle.

WELLSPRING GROVE
Keep to the path. Leave only footprints.
When I was a boy, the river by the Lane ran so fast you could hear it from here.
Now it's dust. Ah, but you've a wildkin with you. Maybe things are turning.
Did you hear that? Water! Up the Lane! I thought I'd never hear it again.
I'm gonna befriend a Puffwren someday. You just have to be really, really gentle.
The flowers in the grove opened! My mum cried. Happy crying.
Rowan! You got a wildkin too? I'm heading up the Lane. Bet I can show you a thing or two!
I fish this stream every morning. Habit. There's been nothing in it but cracked mud for years.
It's running! Look at it run! I'm going to need a bigger basket.
A wall of grey, thorny brambles. They don't budge.
The old stone basin is dry and cracked. You feel a faint warmth deep under the stone.
The Wellspring bubbles and sings. Your friends lean in to drink.
You lay your hand on the stone. Your friends gather close...
Something stirs deep below. Water rises, clear and cold, and begins to sing!
Your friends are worn out... You hurry back to the Mender's hut.
The Mender tends to everyone. Rest well. Some coins were lost on the way.
The grove is alive again. Thank you for playing this first slice of the Vale!
Keep exploring, befriend the rest, and fill your journal.
